unified_features.name: Expenses
unified_features.rationale: Both apps record an expense with different fields; one expense record avoids two ways of entering spending.
unified_features.behaviour: An expense belongs to one budget and has merchant, amount in integer minor units, ISO currency, date, a required category from the fixed list, an optional note and the member who added it. Members list a budget's expenses newest first.
unified_features.improvements: Amount must be a positive integer of minor units (Spendly accepted any value); expenses are stored in a database instead of Spendly's in-memory list.

unified_features.name: Expense categories
unified_features.rationale: The user asked for Spendly's categories; Tallyho's category values are unknown, so its version (M10) was dropped.
unified_features.behaviour: Every expense has exactly one of food, travel, home, other; anything else is rejected with an error and nothing is stored.
unified_features.improvements: Also enforced by a database check constraint.

unified_features.name: Receipt scanning
unified_features.rationale: Requested by the user; only Tallyho has it.
unified_features.behaviour: The user photographs a receipt; an extraction adapter proposes merchant, date, total and currency; a review screen shows every field for correction; the user picks a category and saves, creating one expense.
unified_features.improvements: Date shown and flagged for confirmation (the user reports Tallyho often gets it wrong, and its review screen shows no date); category required before saving; nothing saved without review.

unified_features.name: Foreign-currency conversion
unified_features.rationale: Part of Tallyho's receipt flow; shared budgets need one currency for totals.
unified_features.behaviour: An expense in a currency other than its budget's keeps its original amount and currency and stores the converted amount in the budget currency with the rate and rate date used; budget totals use the converted amount.

unified_features.name: Shared budgets
unified_features.rationale: Requested by the user; only Tallyho has it.
unified_features.behaviour: A budget has a name, a monthly limit and a currency, one owner and members; only members can see or add its expenses; the budget page shows spent vs limit.

unified_features.name: Budget invitations
unified_features.rationale: The way people join a shared budget in Tallyho.
unified_features.behaviour: The owner invites an email address; the invitee gets a single-use link that expires; accepting while signed in with that email makes them a member.

unified_features.name: Member removal
unified_features.rationale: Budget owners need to manage membership.
unified_features.behaviour: Only the owner removes a member; the removed member loses access at once; their earlier expenses stay in the budget, still attributed to them.
unified_features.improvements: Access ends on removal (not stated by Tallyho); the owner cannot remove themself.

unified_features.name: Monthly budget period
unified_features.rationale: Tallyho budgets reset monthly; spent vs limit needs a period.
unified_features.behaviour: Spent vs limit counts expenses dated in the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; earlier months stay viewable; nothing is deleted.
